# Pranav Karra

> Third year Penn State Computer Science major interested in AI interpretability and alignment research.

## Current Roles
- Founding Engineer at stealth startup (Nov 2024-present)
- Researcher at PSU NLP Lab (working with Dr. Rui Zhang on LLM-based bioinformatics)
- President of Machine Learning @ Penn State (120+ members)

## Previous Experience
- Full Stack Engineer at Truvo Insure (built RAG-powered AI chatbots)
- Computer Vision Team Lead at Penn State Robo X (#8 in North America)
- Machine Learning Intern at Manipal Institute of Technology

## Research Interests
- AI Interpretability and Alignment
- Mixture of Experts (MoE) Analysis
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- Concept Unlearning and Vector Steering

## Publications
- MoE Lens - An Expert Is All You Need (OpenReview, March 2025)
  - Study of expert specialization in DeepSeekMoE
  - Found that few specialized experts can approximate full model performance
